headline: Nextpower beat Q2 EPS by 19% and raised its fiscal 2027 range; it had run +4.5% into the print
reasoning: Source: Nextpower's Q2 release (summarized by MarketScreener; Benzinga 18:02 ET) and Benzinga Newsdesk at 16:07-16:10 ET: 'Q2 Adj. EPS $1.31 Beats $1.10 Estimate, Sales $1.109B Beat $1.059B Estimate'. 'Raises FY2027 Adj EPS Guidance from $4.42-$4.73 to $4.61-$4.87 vs $4.63 Est; Raises FY2027 Sales Guidance from $4.100B-$4.400B to $4.200B-$4.450B vs $4.317B Est'.
What changed: a large quarter beat, +19% on EPS and +5% on sales. The full-year EPS midpoint ($4.74) is 2.4% above consensus. The sales midpoint ($4.325B) is about at consensus ($4.317B).

Timing and price: after the close; no session has traded it. After hours: no IEX trades. Into the report the stock rose from 76.49 (Monday) to 83.02 (Wednesday), +8.5% in two sessions, +4.5% on Wednesday alone on 226,423 shares, about 1.6x normal.
objections: +8.5% in the two sessions before the report: some of the beat may already be in the price.
